name: vibepulse-monorepo
description: Production-ready, highly scalable random video chat platform (VibePulse)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix load-test install

author: VibePulse Team
